name: Hope Kilcollins
public_footprint:
SUNY Canton student from the North Country area: named to honors lists including the Spring 2023 honors list (Bachelor of Science in Nursing) and the Fall 2021 Dean's List (Health and Fitness Promotion). As a Brasher Falls/St. Lawrence Central student, presented caffeine research at a STEP conference in Albany.
Sources: https://www.canton.edu/news/2023/honorss23.php; https://5il.co/21z3n
